annotations.title: Malformed-record detection module with pytest tests

description: Produce a standard-library Python module that reports records violating a fixed field contract, plus pytest tests. Choose this when you need one entry per offending record, naming its index and the rule it broke, against a fixed contract. Do not choose this for a contract outside the registered template, or if you need the records corrected rather than reported. Example requests: Write a Python module that finds records violating a fixed field contract, with tests. | I need a checker that reports the index and failed rule for each bad record. | Generate a malformed-record detector and prove it with pytest.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

function_name.description: Name of the function the module must define.

module_name.description: Lowercase module name, used for the file name.

template.description: Which registered behaviour to produce. The behaviour is fixed by the template and verified by the template's own tests.

inputs.title: Malformed-record detection module with pytest tests

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_malformed_record_detection

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.
